trigger.intro: CDD＝客戶盡職審查。先留意適用於所有情況的懷疑／資料疑問，再對照關係及交易類型；各項可同時適用，並非答「是」便略過其餘要求。
cases:
跨情況要求：任何金額
懷疑ML/TF，或懷疑原有身分資料的真實性／充分性

CDD觸發不論金額；另評估STR責任。若合理相信繼續CDD會通風報訊，可停止追查、記錄依據並提交STR。

建立業務關係
不論交易金額

建立前做CDD，不論金額；只有符合全部條件才可延遲核實身分。

已存在業務關係
關係持續期間

持續CDD及交易監察；按觸發事件及風險更新。不是每次交易重新開戶，也不是低額便免查。

非經常交易
電傳／虛擬資產轉帳 ≥ HK$8,000；其他 ≥ HK$120,000（或等值）。單筆或看來相連的交易合計。

達門檻：執行前做CDD。未達門檻：只表示未觸發這項金額條件；上面的懷疑／資料疑問及其他義務仍適用。

trigger.intro: CDD = customer due diligence. Check suspicion / identification doubts across all situations, then the relationship or transaction case. Requirements can coexist; a matching case does not remove other applicable duties.
cases:
Across all cases: any amount
ML/TF suspicion, or doubts about the truth / adequacy of existing identification information

CDD triggers regardless of amount; assess STR duties separately. If reasonably believing that continued CDD would tip off the customer, may stop pursuing it, document the basis and file an STR.

New business relationship
Regardless of transaction amount

CDD before establishment, regardless of amount; defer identity verification only if all conditions are met.

Existing business relationship
Throughout the relationship

Ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring; update on triggers and risk. Neither repeat onboarding for every transaction nor exempt low-value activity.

Occasional transaction
Wire / VA transfer ≥ HK$8,000; others ≥ HK$120,000 (or equivalent). A single operation or linked operations in aggregate.

At threshold: CDD before execution. Below threshold: only this amount-based trigger is absent; the cross-cutting suspicion / doubt trigger and other duties still apply.
